items.docs: Retrieves a quote for a fund event for a given participant code and asset. This endpoint response indicates the rate by which a subsequent on-chain deposit will be honored at.

params.name: participant_code
params.description: Participant code of the end customer

params.name: fund_asset
params.description: The asset sent on-chain by the end customer in order to fund an account

params.name: deposit_address
params.description: The address provided by zerohash that the end customer will send to

params.name: fund_id
params.description: The zerohash-generated unique identifier associated with an executed fund event

params.name: page_size
params.description: The number of results returned per page, with a maximum of 50 transactions per page

params.name: success
params.description: Filters transactions by successful status. This is a boolean field, please specify either `true` or `false`

params.name: deposit_timestamp_gte
params.description: Filter for greater than or equal to a given timestamp

params.name: deposit_timestamp_gt
params.description: Filter for greater than a given timestamp

params.name: deposit_timestamp_lt
params.description: Filter for less than a given timestamp

params.name: deposit_timestamp_lte
params.description: Filter for less than or equal to a given timestamp

params.name: deposit_intent_id
params.description: id returned on JWT creation for correlation purposes

params.name: reference_id
params.description: Filter by the client-provided reference ID (set via client_fund_id when creating the RFQ or provided at JWT generation)

items.docs: You can use the `fund_id` in the response as the “parent” to query `GET /movements?parent_link_id=[fund_id]` to view a trail of all movements related to this fund event.
This endpoint is used to create a new Fiat deposit and enable instant buying power.
